title: Anonymous Letter Against Shanghai Nursing Home -- Dr. Hohlachkin,

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4211
Date 10, 11, 32.

Dear Sir,

I am a nurse attached to the "Shanghai Nursing Home". After seeing all that is taking place in this "boarding house," which is not a hospital at all, I feel compelled to furnish you with information of what is going on.

This place has become a "house of abortion" where many young women have perished. A certificated doctor by the name of Holachkin, who manages this hospital, undertakes abortion cases. In one case he removed an intestine and the woman died. The "doctor" suddenly left Shanghai fearing prosecution by her relatives. After remaining away for some time, he returned to Shanghai and took up residence in the "hospital" because after his departure certain people sold off his office furniture. His substitute, a young female doctor named Antonoff, while undertaking a surgical operation to procure abortion, perforated the uterus, but by a fortunate circumstance the patient is still alive but will become an invalid for the rest of her life.

In another bad case, a young woman entered the hospital with pains in the abdominal cavity but without fever. The female doctor, in order to earn a handsome fee, operated on her for appendicitis. The patient died soon after of peritonitis in consequence of the antiprophylaxis which is generally used in this hospital.

Patients suffering from infectious diseases, such as diphtheria, cholera, angina streptococcique etc, are also admitted.

Patients seriously ill with tuberculosis are not given the necessary attention by the staff. Owing to this it is an indescribable disorder and dirt.

（左侧批注：z.o. 5988）
（左侧批注：D 2816.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 4211
日期 1932年11月10日。

尊敬的先生：

我是隶属于“上海疗养院”（Shanghai Nursing Home）的一名护士。在目睹了这家根本不是医院的“寄宿公寓”里发生的一切后，我觉得有必要向贵处提供有关此处正在发生之事的资讯。

此地已变成一处“堕胎窝”，许多年轻女性在此丧命。管理这家医院的一位持证医生，名为霍拉奇金（Holachkin），专门承接堕胎病例。在其中一例中，他切除了患者的一段肠管，导致该妇女死亡。这位“医生”因惧怕死者亲属起诉而突然离开上海。在外躲避一段时间后，他返回上海并重新住进该“医院”，因为在他离开期间，某些人变卖了他的办公家具。他的替任者是一位名叫安东诺夫（Antonoff）的年轻女医生，她在进行堕胎手术时刺穿了子宫，所幸患者虽保住性命，但将终身残疾。

在另一桩恶劣案例中，一名年轻女子因腹腔疼痛但无发热症状入院。该女医生为了赚取高额诊费，对其进行了阑尾炎手术。由于该医院普遍缺乏预防性消毒措施，患者术后很快因腹膜炎死亡。

患有白喉、霍乱、链球菌性咽峡炎等传染病的患者也被收治。

患有严重结核病的患者未得到工作人员必要的照料。因此，院内混乱不堪，肮脏至极，难以形容。

（左侧批注：z.o. 5988）
（左侧批注：D 2816.）

page_data.en:
The death certificaes are inscribed with false
diagnosis and everything is well concealed from Police
inspection.

In my opinion, all these things are taking place
because the hospital is under the management of a woman
without any knowledge of medicine, such as Mrs. Danenberg
who, after donning a blouse and cap, issues formal orders
and takes part in an operation in decollete cut as low as
the navel and with long finger nails after a manicure.
Every one knows that she used to work in Harbin as a
stenographer in an office. In Shanghai she used to work
as a stenographer and cashier in the "Blue Hospital" and
later when she was manageress of this institution she
became a nurse. None of the doctors asked for her
diploma. Dr. Hohlachkin and Dr. Antonoff are fully aware
of what she is, but then they have an excellent place to
procure abortion and with her assistance they can hide all
the bad cases.

And now Mrs. Danenberg, who calls herself a
nurse, takes part in operations. In one instance, while
wearing sterilized gloves, she began to rub her forehead.
Under such conditions more and more serious cases of blood
poisoning will occur. Mrs. Polinkovsky died of blood-
poisoning after an operation for appendicitis by Dr. Antonoff.
Mrs. Danenberg and the female doctor Antonoff are on very
friendly terms and enjoy themselves together every night.
From this one can imagine the kind of work that is being
done in this hospital.

As for the conduct and morals of the female
doctor Antonoff you can secure information from any Russian
doctor and he will tell you everything. She was a member
of the Russian Medical Association but was obliged to quit.
〔此处转录不清〕
page_data.zh:
死亡证明书上填写的是虚假诊断，所有情况都巧妙地避开了警方的检查。

在我看来，之所以发生这一切，是因为该医院由一位毫无医学知识的女性管理，即达嫩伯格夫人（Mrs. Danenberg）。她穿上护士服和帽子，便发号施令，甚至参与手术，穿着领口低至肚脐的服装，留着修过指甲的长指甲。众所周知，她曾在哈尔滨的一间办公室担任速记员。在上海，她曾在“蓝色医院”（Blue Hospital）担任速记员和出纳，后来当上该机构的经理后，又摇身一变成为护士。没有任何一位医生查验过她的文凭。霍拉奇金医生（Dr. Hohlachkin）和安东诺夫医生（Dr. Antonoff）完全清楚她的底细，但他们拥有一个极佳的堕胎场所，并在她的协助下掩盖所有恶性案件。

如今，自称护士的达嫩伯格夫人也参与手术。有一次，她戴着无菌手套，却开始揉搓自己的额头。在这种情况下，败血症病例将愈发严重。波林科夫斯基夫人（Mrs. Polinkovsky）在安东诺夫医生为其进行阑尾炎手术后，死于败血症。达嫩伯格夫人与女医生安东诺夫关系极为密切，每晚一起寻欢作乐。由此可以想象这家医院的工作性质。

至于女医生安东诺夫的品行和道德，您可以向任何一位俄国医生打听，他们会告知您一切。她曾是俄罗斯医学会成员，但被迫退出。
〔此处转录不清〕

    I am a nurse who has completed a high course.
I have studied for several months the necessity of washing
the hands in order to be allowed to take part in an
operation.  I am sending you all this information so that
you may keep your eye on what is going on.
    If you desire, I can furnish you the names of
the patients who have been treated in this hospital.  This
can be easily done from the file in which the names of the
patients are entered(as well as the patients of the female
doctor Antonoff) or by discreetly asking them for the
information.  We are three nurses who are fully informed
of what is taking place in the hospital and we have resolved
to reveal the whole truth.
                    (unsigned)

                    (未署名)
